summary: Outlook Therapeutics filed an 8-K to disclose entry into an at-the-market offering agreement with H.C. Wainwright, allowing the company to sell up to $100M of common stock at prevailing market prices. This is a routine capital-raising facility, not a special situation. The agreement includes a 3% commission and customary representations. The offering is made under an existing effective shelf registration statement. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is involved. The filing is purely an ordinary shelf takedown arrangement.
